goal: Make KitCode Welcome open reliably on Windows first-run, and never report success when the Electron process is missing or exits immediately.

in: Treat Electron Welcome/setup launch as successful only after the child process stays alive for a short ready window.
Surface clear errors when Electron is missing or exits before Welcome opens; exit nonzero for failed kitcode setup.
Do not use windowsHide:true for Electron GUI Welcome/companion launches so Windows can show the desktop window.
Print Opening KitCode Welcome... from the shared onboarding open path; fail codex/claude on Welcome launch cleanly when onboarding is incomplete.
Update generated assistant/setup prompts so agents do not tell users to finish Welcome after a failed launch.
Add focused source checks covering launch wait, Windows GUI spawn flags, setup failure messaging, and prompt failure guidance.
out: No Welcome UI redesign or onboarding flow changes.
No making Electron a hard npm dependency.
No full Windows native E2E harness in CI.
No changes to git/hook/daemon windowsHide behavior for non-GUI subprocesses.
No reward, tracker, or state schema changes.

acceptance_criteria.summary: openElectronEntry waits for the Electron child to remain alive briefly before returning success, and treats early exit/spawn error as failure with detail.
Electron GUI Welcome/companion spawn uses windowsHide:false so Windows does not suppress the desktop window.
kitcode setup prints Opening KitCode Welcome..., and exits nonzero with actionable Electron help when launch fails.
When onboarding is incomplete, codex/claude on opens Welcome through the shared path and reports failure instead of claiming success silently.
Assistant/setup prompts instruct agents to report Electron/Welcome launch failures and not ask the user to complete a window that never appeared.

coverage_plan.summary: Assert launch wait, windowsHide:false for GUI Electron, setup failure exit path, and Opening KitCode Welcome shared print.
Assert assistant and setup prompts require reporting failed Welcome launches instead of false completion instructions.

risks.summary: A short liveness wait may still return success before Chromium finishes showing on slow Windows machines.
risks.mitigation: Keep the wait long enough to catch immediate exits; still surface exit errors when the process dies during the window.

risks.summary: Windows npm optionalDependency installs may still omit Electron; launch will correctly fail but users must reinstall.
risks.mitigation: Keep actionable reinstall messaging; do not pretend Welcome opened.

risks.summary: Setting windowsHide:false for Electron GUI may briefly flash a console on some Windows setups.
risks.mitigation: Prefer a visible Welcome window over a hidden failed launch; keep windowsHide for non-GUI subprocesses.

implementation_handoff.summary: Fix silent Electron Welcome launch on Windows by waiting for process liveness, allowing the GUI to show, failing setup/on clearly, and updating agent prompts.
suggested_sequence: Make openElectronEntry async and wait for early exit before success; use windowsHide:false for GUI Electron.
Route setup and incomplete codex/claude on through shared Opening/failure messaging with nonzero setup exit.
Update assistant/setup prompts for failed Welcome launch handling.
Extend focused CLI and integration-spec checks.
current_behavior_evidence: openElectronEntry returns true immediately after spawn with stdio ignore and windowsHide:true, then unrefs.
kitcode setup calls openOnboardingWindow without awaiting or checking failure exit status.
Windows symptom report: never appears, no Electron process, never worked, exit 0 with no output.
